$comment: OpenNexus 'Luminous Graphite' tokens, transcribed from artboards 02 System, 03 Themes, 04 Motion and NS Node styles. Source of truth is the artboards; if this file and an artboard disagree, the artboard wins and this file should be fixed.

amber.role: Connect mode (ink text only, never white text)

branchPalette.$comment: Classic theme, 8 colours, assigned to main branches in order. Smart Color (⇧⌘R) reshuffles.

semantic.$comment: Never colour alone: every semantic state carries a glyph or pattern.

mono.use: code, keys, metadata, ports, edge labels

designFonts.$comment: Fonts used in the design artboards only. Ship the app with system fonts (SF Pro / SF Mono / New York) except the Sketch node style, which needs a handwriting font (Kalam, OFL) or an equivalent bundled OFL font.

materials.glass: Toolbar, palette, floating toolbar, HUDs, prompt bar. Never behind node text.
materials.opaque: Canvas and nodes. Reduce Transparency swaps all glass for opaque surface.

rules: Text input is live at 0 ms; layout animates after, never before, the user can type.
New input retargets in-flight springs; never queue animations.
Reduce Motion: replace movement with a 150 ms cross-fade.

canvasStatePill.$comment: Always visible bottom-left. Shape + colour + word.

themes.contrast: All themes WCAG AA for node text; High Contrast AAA.

nodeStyles.$comment: Independent of theme (colours) and structure (layout). Exact CSS per role is in design/source/NodeStyles.dc.html (defs array) and Prototype.dc.html (styleLook()). Cycle with ⌥⌘S, 300 ms morph.
nodeStyles.outline: White card, 2 pt border in branch colour; ink root. Default.
nodeStyles.soft: Tinted fills (14% main, 7% sub), no borders, generous radius.
nodeStyles.solid: Saturated branch-colour fill, white type (ink on light hues).
nodeStyles.underline: Text sits on its branch line (3 pt main, 1.5 pt sub); pill-outlined root.
nodeStyles.capsule: Full pill radius, 10% tint + 60% hairline ring.
nodeStyles.sketch: Wobble borders (asymmetric radii), handwriting font, warm paper canvas.
nodeStyles.brutal: 2–2.5 pt ink borders, hard offset shadow in branch colour, elbow lines, yellow root.
nodeStyles.glow: Dark canvas, hairline neon border + outer glow, glowing lines.
nodeStyles.minimal: No boxes; weight and colour only; dotted hairline branches.
